content: Domain adaptation has been successfully applied on computer vision BIBREF9 and speech recognition BIBREF10 . It is also widely studied on NLP tasks such as sequence tagging and parsing BIBREF11 , BIBREF12 , BIBREF13 . Recently, adversarial domain adaptation has already been explored on spoken language understanding (SLU). Liu and Lane learned domain-general features to benefit from multiple dialogue datasets BIBREF14 ; Zhu et al. learned to transfer the model from the transcripts side to the ASR hypotheses side BIBREF15 ; Lan et al. constructed a shared space for slot tagging and language model BIBREF16 . This paper extends the capability of adversarial domain adaptation for SQA, which has not been explored yet.
